name: market-watch
description: Real-Time Market Watch: React + Vite frontend and NestJS WebSocket backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run verify:stack && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
